properties.title: LP Neutron Spectrometer Hydrogen 2° Abundance (low-altitude)
properties.lri:quality_note: Hydrogen abundances are not necessarily reliable in regions of high thorium and rare-earth element abundances (Maurice et al. 2001a). Use with caution in KREEP-rich terranes (elevated Th, K & REE drive neutron bias).
properties.measurement_depth: few tens of centimeters (bulk subsurface, not surface)
properties.processing:lineage: Raw INT16 binary (hydrogenlow.dat) scaled ÷10 via gdal_calc.py to obtain H ppm as Float32. Derived from LP epithermal neutron data corrected by thermal neutron data acquired during the low-altitude mission phase; converted to H ppm via equations 3 and 4 of Feldman et al. (2001c). Written as COG via gdal_translate with DEFLATE/PREDICTOR=3 compression.
